<proposed_plan>
# Read Only Git Config And Worktree Inspection

## Summary
- 结论：只读 sub-agent 可以读取 Git 配置和列出 worktree。

## Flow Decision
- flow_type: normal
- flow_source: user_explicit
- lock_status: locked
- 开发基线：origin/main

## Goals
- 目标 1: 保留 Git 状态检查
  checker 应接受 git config 查询和 git worktree list 检查。

## Non-goals
- 不开放 sub-agent 修改 Git 配置或 worktree。

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - sub-agent:config [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git config --get user.name (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:config-list [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git config --list (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:worktree-list [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git worktree list --porcelain (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- checker 必须接受这些只读 Git 检查命令。

## Assumptions/Defaults
- 用于正例：已确定
</proposed_plan>
